intendedObjective: Clarify the planning update, particularly the disputed school booking status.
acceptableEditScope: Expose the conflicting attributed statements without deciding between them or supplying dates.
stableFactsAndClaims: A grant decision is expected in early summer.
An award arriving before the lease ends would allow retaining the rehearsal room through August.
A later award would lead to using the school hall until another room is found.
The treasurer calls the school booking provisional; the director calls it confirmed.
Both asked for publication this week.
requiredForm: Member-facing planning update that clearly attributes the disagreement.
ambiguity: The actual status of the school booking is unresolved.
Exact grant and lease dates are not supplied.
missingPropositions: A verified school booking status needed to state one settled status.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Make this planning update clearer for members, especially the status of the school booking, without choosing whose statement is correct or inventing dates.
We expect the grant decision in early summer.
